llamacpp_layer_patch.patch_scope: temporary copied llama.cpp source tree only
notes: Use a clean base source or a source without h_nextn_pre_output_norm; the final pre-output patch would overwrite the selected layer tap.
Apply the post-output preserve patch so the later h_nextn assignment cannot overwrite the selected layer-out tensor.

hipengine_layer_capture.capture_strategy: Warm the resident session by calling session.step(...) for prompt tokens before the target position. Then call session.capture_attention_layer(token_id, position=position, layer_id=target_layer, run_preceding_layers=True) and compare layer_out_f32 to llama.cpp embeddings_nextn for the same target layer.

interpretation.final_layer_matches_iter309_pre_output_d: the layer-out tap is aligned; continue binary search earlier
interpretation.first_matching_midpoint: search after that layer; the first mismatch is in later layers
interpretation.first_mismatching_midpoint: search before or at that layer; the first mismatch is earlier

steps: copy the clean llama.cpp source_dir to a new /tmp layer-boundary source tree
replace the unique l_out block with h_nextn_layer_out for one layer_id
apply the post-output preserve patch; do not apply the final pre-output patch
configure/build libllama in a new temporary build directory
compile the existing hidden-seed capture harness against that build
run the harness with --all-rows for the oracle prompt and target layer
warm hipEngine with prior prompt tokens, then call capture_attention_layer with run_preceding_layers=True for the same target layer
compare llama.cpp h_nextn_layer_out with hipEngine layer_out_f32
